title: Gauge
description: A half-ring of equal sections filled clockwise to a share of the whole: full sections in needle-700, the one the share ends in mixed toward needle-200 by its coverage, the rest the track. An optional mark is a red diamond inside the ring at another share, the ring carved away around it. Children sit inside the arc.

anatomy.description: The root with data-slot="gauge"; measures its own width with visx useParentSize and draws an SVG of that width and half its radius in height, role="img" with the summary.
One visx Arc per section; its fill is a color-mix set inline, so the partial section's tone follows the value.
A rounded square rotated on its corner at the tick share, categorical-3; its halo in the SVG mask cuts the surface around it.
Children placed at the arc's baseline centre: the figure, usually in the display size, with a chip or a caption under it.

usage: value and tick are shares, 0 to 1; format writes them for the spoken summary (a percent formatter).
Name the tick with tickLabel so the summary reads 'last season 54%' rather than 'before'.
Give the gauge a container with a known width; it fills it and caps its radius at 140px.
The empty-to-full tone is one hue (needle) so the fill reads as progress, never as a category.
